Product Features

  • Combination in modern minimalist style: TV cabinet and coffee table in a uniform design in light walnut wood, simple and generous in modern minimalist style, and a variety of living environments perfectly integrated to enhance the overall room aesthetics
  • Multifunctional Storage Design: The TV cabinet is equipped with double drawers that provide plenty of storage space, while the coffee table underneath has open shelves that make it easy to categorize and store books, remote controls, and other small items to keep the living room tidy.
  • HIGH-QUALITY ECO-FRIENDLY MATERIALS: Both pieces of furniture are made of high-density MDF with scratch and wear-resistant surfaces, and are eco-friendly and pollution-free, ensuring safe and healthy use.
  • STABLE SOLID WOOD SUPPORT: The TV stand and coffee table are equipped with solid wooden legs, which are sturdy and durable. The four legs in the middle of the TV stand are height-adjustable, adapting to different ground conditions and providing greater stability.
  • Humanized Design Details: TV cabinet and coffee table are equipped with invisible vertical handles, simple and beautiful, reducing the risk of bumping; oval table top, comfortable and rounded, not only beautiful but also safe, especially for families with children.
